era: The 2017-2020 mayoclinic.org design seen by all visitors in 2019: serif MAYO CLINIC shield logo, grey-bevelled search box, utility links, a seven-item nav bar with grey triangles, blue APPOINTMENTS / FIND A DOCTOR / CONTACT US / PATIENT & VISITOR GUIDE tiles, Helvetica body type and a charcoal (#27251f) footer with For Medical Professionals / For Students / For Researchers / For Job Seekers / For International Patients / Charitable Care / Follow Mayo Clinic / Free E-Newsletter / Make a Donation. Captures 2019-03, 2019-07, 2019-09 and 2019-11 agree.
